events.body:
## Context

`blt-vanish/flutter_app/lib/services/broker_service.dart:9` uses `https://Vanish.workers.dev` and `blt-vanish-flutter/lib/services/broker_service.dart:9` uses `https://selferase.workers.dev`. Neither resolves, so both apps wait for a timeout before falling back. `https://vanish.owaspblt.org/api/brokers` returns the broker list.

## What to do

1. Set the base URL to `https://vanish.owaspblt.org` in both files.
2. Optional: inject an `http.Client` and add a MockClient test for primary-then-fallback (pattern: `blt-netguardian-client/test/services/task_manager_test.dart`).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Both apps load brokers from the primary endpoint
- [ ] (Optional) a unit test covers the fallback order

## How to test locally

```bash
cd blt-vanish/flutter_app && flutter test   # needs the Flutter SDK
```

---
